meta.move: Long messages with curly quotes and a concession
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?

I want to be fair to Owen. I compared the essay with his in-class writing from September 24: 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices throughout, no quotations. This essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and none of those errors.

Forty minutes in class with no book against a weekend at home with the play open, so of course one has quotations and the other doesn't. Fair would have been a phone call before the zero went in. Show me both pieces, side by side.
You’re right that the checker alone proves nothing. I’m taking it off the table. I’m relying on the writing and the version history.
I hadn't said a word about the checker yet, but I'm writing down that it's off the table. Version history of what, made when, and who has seen it? Turn the screen, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you agreed that the AI checker result is off the table as a basis for Owen's zero. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that you apologise for entering it before anyone contacted me, and that nothing about this goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see your documents; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended before your evidence was ever on the screen, not because her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing moved her, though dropping the checker earned a note on her pad, because you described evidence without letting her read any of it.
What cost ground: You never addressed the zero going into the gradebook before anyone called her, which was her first question and her strongest procedural point.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never got near that night, since you named only a September in-class sample and a version history with no times; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided and on what basis, open with one sentence owning that the zero went in before you called her, then turn the screen and show her the version history with its dates and times.
